method: Voxel occupancy + distance-field offset + binary closing/fill + smoothed signed-distance marching cubes
rhino_equivalence: Shrink-wrap-style approximation; Rhino 8 proprietary ShrinkWrap internals are not reproduced or validated.
coordinate_frame: Input coordinates, preserved without rotation or translation
topology_validation: Closed-edge, vertex-manifold and orientability checks; full global triangle self-intersection search is not run. The watertight field records these checks, not an independent intersection-free guarantee.
limitations: Offset, gap closing, enclosed-void filling and crop-end caps infer unobserved geometry.
This is a solid envelope proxy, not measured trunk diameters, biomass, leaf area or validated CFD geometry.
Adding an optional open ground sheet produces an open combined scene.
Nearby surfaces can merge at the chosen scale. Small isolated components are removed.
Input alignment uncertainty is inherited; meshing does not estimate or correct registration.
